resources.string: Locks the apps you choose behind your fingerprint, face, or screen lock

Bio Key uses this service to see which app is on screen, so it can cover apps you\'ve chosen to lock until you authenticate. When you tap an app on the home screen, in search or in Recents, it reads that app\'s name so a locked app is covered before it opens. If you turn on self-protection in Bio Key\'s settings, it also recognises Bio Key\'s own App info, accessibility, notification access and uninstall screens, so switching Bio Key off requires your authentication.\n\nBio Key does not read what you type, does not record the screen, and has no internet access. Nothing it observes leaves your device.
